Government Agency: Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires AL DL#, DOB, SSN. Direct retail portal through Alabama Interactive. Commercial providers pull in <30s via state partner gateway.

Government Agency: Alaska Division of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires AK DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. Official digital copy sent immediately via email and web download.

Government Agency: Arizona Dept. of Transportation - Motor Vehicle Division (ADOT MVD)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (AZ MVD Now API & Commercial Bulk Services)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires AZ MVD Now account, DL#, SSN. $3 for 39-month uncertified, $5 for 5-year certified. One of the cheapest states.

Government Agency: Arkansas Dept. of Finance and Administration (DFA) - Driver Services
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires AR DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. Base statutory fee is $8.50 + $4.20 online electronic service fee. Complete history requires mail.

Government Agency: California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (CA DMV Requester Code / EPN Commercial Gateway)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires MyDMV account, CA DL#, DOB, SSN. Base fee $2.00 (+1.95% card fee). Single print/save session. Employers use Employer Pull Notice (EPN).

Government Agency: Colorado Department of Revenue - Division of Motor Vehicles
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires myDMV account, CO DL/Permit#, DOB, SSN. Certified copies cost $10.25 via mail/in-person.

Government Agency: Connecticut Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires CT.gov account, CT DL#, Name, DOB. Downloadable PDF stored in account dashboard for 30 days.

Government Agency: Delaware Division of Motor Vehicles (myDMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires myDMV account, DE DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. One of the highest state statutory fees ($25.00 flat).

Government Agency: Florida Dept. of Highway Safety & Motor Vehicles (FLHSMV)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (FLHSMV Driver Record Monitoring & Commercial Gateway)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires FL DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. $8 base for 3-yr, $10 base for 7-yr/complete + $2 portal convenience fee. Free status check available.

Government Agency: Georgia Department of Driver Services (DDS)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (GA DDS Bulk MVR Service & Partner Gateway)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires MyDDS account, GA DL#, DOB, SSN. Discounted to $6.00 / $8.00 if using DDS 2 GO mobile app.

Government Agency: Hawaii Judiciary & DOT (via eHawaii.gov / Tyler Hawaii)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Traffic records administered by Judiciary. Tyler Hawaii powers the 30-sec electronic bulk commercial portal ($23/record). In-person is $20.

Government Agency: Idaho Transportation Department (ITD) - Division of Motor Vehicles
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires ID DL#, Last 4 SSN, DOB. $7.00 statutory fee + $3.50 Tyler portal fee = $10.50 total.

Government Agency: Illinois Secretary of State (CyberDriveIllinois)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (IL SOS Commercial Driver Abstract API)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires IL DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN, and Document Discriminator (DD#) from card. Increased from $12 to $20 statutory fee.

Government Agency: Indiana Bureau of Motor Vehicles (myBMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires myBMV account, IN DL#, SSN. Free to view online; $4.00 + $0.40 card fee for official certified record.

Government Agency: Iowa Department of Transportation (Iowa DOT) - myMVD
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires IA DL#, Name, DOB, Last 5 SSN. Free unofficial view; $5.50 + $3.00 processing for certified copy.

Government Agency: Kansas Department of Revenue (KDOR) - Driver Solutions
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires KS DL#, DOB, DPPA permissible purpose certification. Free basic status check available on KDOR.

Government Agency: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) - Drive.ky.gov
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires KY DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. $3.00 base + $3.00 online convenience fee. Full records require in-person visit.

Government Agency: Louisiana Office of Motor Vehicles (OMV ExpressLane)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires LA DL#, Full Name, DOB, Address. System unavailable nightly between 11:30 PM - 4:00 AM CST.

Government Agency: Maine Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV) - InforME
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires ME DL#, Name, DOB. $7 for 3-year record, $12 for 10-year record. Must print immediately.

Government Agency: Maryland Dept. of Transportation - Motor Vehicle Administration (myMVA)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires myMVA login, MD DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. $12 for non-certified, $15 for certified.

Government Agency: Massachusetts Dept. of Transportation - Registry of Motor Vehicles (myRMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires myRMV login, MA DL#, DOB, SSN. $8.00 for unattested record. Attested (court) records are $20.00.

Government Agency: Michigan Department of State - Secretary of State (e-Services)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (MI SOS Commercial Record Lookup Service)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires MiLogin account, MI DL#, DOB, SSN. Certified PDF accessible in user dashboard for 7 days.

Government Agency: Minnesota Dept. of Public Safety - Driver & Vehicle Services (DVS)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (MN DVS Record Service Electronic Gateway)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires MyDVS account, MN DL#, SSN, DOB. Fee is $9.00 standard or $10.00 certified (paid via bank ACH).

Government Agency: Mississippi Department of Public Safety - Driver Service Bureau
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires MS DL#, Full Name, DOB, SSN. $11 base + $3.31 tech fee. Link active for 24 hours.

Government Agency: Missouri Department of Revenue (DOR) - MyDMV
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (MO DOR Commercial Driver Record System)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires MO DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. Statutory fee is $2.82 + online convenience fee. One of the lowest base fees.

Government Agency: Montana Department of Justice - Motor Vehicle Division (MVD)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires MT DL#, Full Name, DOB, Last 4 SSN. Must save/print immediately as session expires.

Government Agency: Nebraska Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) - Nebraska.gov
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires NE DL# or SSN, Name, DOB, DPPA exemption. $3.00 search fee + $12.00 portal fee = $15.00 total.

Government Agency: Nevada Department of Motor Vehicles (MyDMV)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (NV DMV Commercial Record Access Portal)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires MyDMV account, NV DL#, SSN, DOB. $7.00 flat fee for 3-year or 10-year record.

Government Agency: New Hampshire Division of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires NH DL#, DOB, Full Name. $15.00 base + $5.00 portal enhancement fee.

Government Agency: New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission (NJMVC)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (NJ MVC CAIR / Commercial Abstract System)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires NJ User ID, NJ DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. Covers moving violations, points, and suspensions over past 5 years.

Government Agency: New Mexico Taxation & Revenue - Motor Vehicle Division (MVD)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires NM DL#, DOB, Last 6 SSN. Non-certified is $6.63; certified record with verification seal is $9.99.

Government Agency: New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (MyDMV)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (NY DMV DALLS / License Event Notification System)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires NY MyDMV login, NY DL/ID#, Last 4 SSN. $7 flat fee. Commercial fleets use NY DMV LENS monitoring.

Government Agency: North Carolina Division of Motor Vehicles (myNCDMV / PayIt)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires NC DL#, DOB, SSN/ITIN. Base is $12.75 uncertified / $18.00 certified + $3 PayIt service fee + 1.85% card fee.

Government Agency: North Dakota Department of Transportation (NDDOT)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires ND DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. $3 flat fee. Must print/save immediately during the online session.

Government Agency: Ohio Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (OH BMV Electronic Commercial Record System)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires OH DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. 2-year unofficial record is completely free; 3-year official abstract is $5 + $1.75 fee.

Government Agency: Service Oklahoma (SOK Navigate)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires OK DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. Statutory fee $25.00 + $2.50 online fee. Certified record is $28.00 + $2.50.

Government Agency: Oregon Dept. of Transportation - Driver & Motor Vehicle Services (DMV2U)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires OR DL#, Name, DOB, Address. Lowest state fee in the nation ($1.50-$2.00). Court print is $3.00.

Government Agency: Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (PennDOT Business Partner Online Driver Record System)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires PA DL#, DOB, Last 4 SSN. $14 flat fee online. Certified copies require mail Form DL-503 ($47.00).

Government Agency: Rhode Island Division of Motor Vehicles (RI DMV / RI.gov)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires RI DL# (7 digits), Last Name, DOB, Zip Code. $20.00 base + $1.50 RI.gov portal fee.

Government Agency: South Carolina Department of Motor Vehicles (SCDMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires SC DL#, SSN, DOB. Online purchase allows immediate PDF download while physical copy is mailed.

Government Agency: South Dakota Department of Public Safety (DPS)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: PM Critical Insight: SD lacks a direct citizen self-service portal (retail uses mail/notarized form for $7), BUT provides electronic access to credentialed commercial MVR aggregators (AAMVA/SambaSafety/Checkr) who return in <30 seconds.

Government Agency: Tennessee Department of Safety & Homeland Security
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (TN Dept of Safety Commercial MVR Portal)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires TN DL#, DOB, SSN, Last 5 digits of DD# on card. $5 flat fee. Fast instant download.

Government Agency: Texas Department of Public Safety (TX DPS)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (TX DPS Electronic Driver Record Commercial Interface)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires TX DL#, Audit # from physical card, DOB, Last 4 SSN. Type 2 (3-yr) is $6.50; Type 3A (certified defensive driving) is $12.00.

Government Agency: Utah Department of Public Safety - Driver License Division (DLD)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires UT DL#, DOB, card billing address matching DL records. $8.00 base + $3.00 portal fee = $11.00 total.

Government Agency: Vermont Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (Tyler Vermont / VIC Commercial Driver Record Interface)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: PM Critical Insight: Individual retail requests use mail/appointment (Forms VG-116), but commercial background check partners access the Vermont Information Consortium electronic gateway for instant sub-30-second return.

Government Agency: Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (VA DMV Commercial Extranet & Monitoring Service)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires VA DMV login, VA DL/Customer#, SSN, DOB. $8 online ($9 in-person/mail). Accessible for 5 days.

Government Agency: Washington State Department of Licensing (DOL License eXpress)
Commercial / API Gateway Available: Yes (WA DOL Business License eXpress & Commercial ADR)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires SecureAccess Washington (SAW) / License eXpress account, WA DL#, DOB. $15.00 flat fee.

Government Agency: West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles (WV DMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires WV DL#, Full Legal Name, DOB, Last 4 SSN. $7.50 with DL# ($8.50 without) + portal fee.

Government Agency: Wisconsin Department of Transportation (WisDOT DMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires WI DL/ID#, DOB, Last 4 SSN, and camera verification. $5.00 via ACH (card has small convenience fee).

Government Agency: Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT / oneWYO)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Requires oneWYO login (via Login.gov), WY DL#, DOB. $10.00 flat fee per record.

Government Agency: District of Columbia Department of Motor Vehicles (DC DMV)
Key Requirements & PM Notes: Bonus 51st US jurisdiction. Requires DC DL#, Name, DOB, SSN. $7 base + 2.5% card fee.
